segments.name: Platform
segments.description: Transforms public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, AI-powered efficient digital networks through modular software and services.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized into one reportable segment, the Platform segment.

revenueModel.text: Government agencies and private organizations pay recurring subscription fees for software platform access and technology-enabled services to manage transit networks.
revenueModel.evidence: In each of the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we generated 97% of our revenue from recurring subscription fees.

changes.text: In 2024, the Legacy segment operating contract terminated in June 2024 and was not renewed as the company focused on the Platform segment.
